services:
  app:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    environment:
      DB_HOST: db
      DB_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    develop:
      watch:
        - action: sync
          path: ./templates
          target: /app/templates
        - action: rebuild
          path: requirements.txt

  db:
    image: postgres:18
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "-U", "postgres"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 15

volumes:
  pgdata:
